put off: To make someone wait, or to say no in a nice way.
slip out: To go out without being seen or heard.
pull oneself together: To get control of your feelings again.
settle down: To make a place your home, or to stop moving about and rest.
shed tears: To let tears fall from your eyes.
slip away: To go away without being seen or heard.
cast off: To let go of the line that holds a boat, so that it can move away.
get a rise out of: To make someone angry by a joke or a plan.
make a fool of: To act in a way that makes people laugh at you.
the game is up: There is no more hope that the plan will work.
